title: S&P 500 ends down after Trump says Iran deal is 'over'
title_zh: 特朗普表示伊朗协议“结束”后标普 500 指数收低
summary: STORY: U.S. stocks finished mostly lower on Wednesday, with the Dow dropping about 1% and the S&P 500 shedding more than a quarter of a percent.
summary_zh: 故事：美国股市周三收盘大多走低，道指下跌约 1%，标准普尔 500 指数跌幅超过 25%。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rose after US strikes Iran for second day
title_zh: 今日股市：美国连续第二天袭击伊朗后道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货上涨
summary: US stock futures slipped as the US struck Iran for the second day in a row, hours after President Trump declared the ceasefire between the two countries "over."
summary_zh: 在特朗普总统宣布两国停火“结束”数小时后，美国连续第二天袭击伊朗，美国股指期货下跌。

title: Jeff Bezos's Blue Origin is looking to fuel growth. What does that mean for rival SpaceX?
title_zh: 杰夫·贝索斯的蓝色起源正在寻求推动增长。这对竞争对手 SpaceX 意味着什么？
summary: SpaceX (SPCX) rival Blue Origin, which is owned by Amazon (AMZN) founder Jeff Bezos, is reportedly seeking $10 billion in fresh funding. Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley breaks down the details.
summary_zh: 据报道，亚马逊 (AMZN) 创始人杰夫·贝索斯 (Jeff Bezos) 旗下的 SpaceX (SPCX) 竞争对手蓝色起源 (Blue Origin) 正在寻求 100 亿美元的新资金。雅虎财经突发商业新闻记者杰克·康利 (Jake Conley) 详细分析了这些细节。

title: The uncertainty investors should anticipate from midterm elections
title_zh: 投资者应预期中期选举的不确定性
summary: The US midterm elections are just a few months away, so what do they represent for US markets (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) in the meantime? Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré outlines the uncertainty that midterm election years bring to markets.
summary_zh: 距离美国中期选举只有几个月的时间了，那么在此期间它们对美国市场（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）代表什么？雅虎财经高级商业记者 Ines Ferré 概述了中期选举年给市场带来的不确定性。

title: China warned that Anthropic's Claude Code puts your data at risk. Is that true?
title_zh: 中国警告称，Anthropic 的克劳德代码会使您的数据面临风险。这是真的吗？
summary: Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley discusses China's warning that Anthropic's (ANTH.PVT) Claude Code could expose sensitive user data.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经科技编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 讨论了中国关于 Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) 克劳德代码可能泄露敏感用户数据的警告。

title: Meta is expanding its data center build-out to Canada
title_zh: Meta 正在将其数据中心建设扩展到加拿大
summary: Meta says it will build its first data center in Canada.
summary_zh: Meta 表示将在加拿大建立第一个数据中心。

title: Broadcom stock jumps on Apple AI chip deal, while Nvidia's relative stock price drops
title_zh: 博通股价因苹果人工智能芯片交易而上涨，而英伟达的相对股价下跌
summary: Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton takes a closer look at some of Wednesday's trending tickers and stories, including Nvidia's (NVDA) relative stock price; Broadcom's (AVGO) and Apple's (AAPL) AI chip deal; and travel-related stocks like Carnival (CCL), United (UAL), and Delta (DAL).
summary_zh: 雅虎财经的 Josh Lipton 仔细研究了周三的一些热门股票和故事，包括 Nvidia (NVDA) 的相对股价；博通（AVGO）和苹果（AAPL）的人工智能芯片交易；以及与旅游相关的股票，如嘉年华 (CCL)、联合航空 (UAL) 和达美航空 (DAL)。

title: Nvidia's $1 trillion rout: Do you buy or sell the stock here?
title_zh: 英伟达1万亿美元暴跌：你在这里买还是卖股票？

title: Nvidia's valuation just hit a multiyear low — even as revenue sets records
title_zh: 英伟达的估值刚刚触及多年来的低点——尽管收入创下了纪录
summary: Nvidia's forward P/E ratio is at its lowest since 2019.
summary_zh: 英伟达的远期市盈率处于 2019 年以来的最低水平。
